summary: Full-extraction pass over six stored Brazilian documents on investor residence (RN 13 business and RN 36/46 real-estate routes): two CNIg resolutions, a government release, the OBMigra Q2 2019 quarterly report and the 2022 and 2025 annual reports. Added 415 observations (mostly the Q2 2019 tables by country and state for prior and in-country authorisations, the 2022 report's continent, country, region and profile splits, and the 2025 report's regional investment tables read by OCR), 11 terms and 4 events, plus one proposed indicator.

program_terms.applies_to: initial real-estate investor residence authorisation: valid up to four years, renewable indefinitely while the criteria are kept
program_terms.quote: A autorização inicial tem validade de até quatro anos e pode ser renovada indefinidamente, desde que os critérios estabelecidos sejam mantidos.
program_terms.notes: Rule as described by the government release of 3 Dec 2024 (it names RN 36/2018 as the basis; RN 36 itself gave 2 years, see bra-dou-rn-36-2018). "Up to" four years: 4 is a maximum. Start date of this rule not given.

program_terms.applies_to: execution period of the investment or business plan required of every RN 13 investor
program_terms.quote: O Plano de Investimento ou de Negócios, com prazo de execução de 03 (três) anos, deverá conter os seguintes tópicos
program_terms.notes: The plan must cover hiring in the first three years, salaries, staff training and use of the funds. RN 13 in force on publication in the DOU (22 Dec 2017).

program_terms.applies_to: investor applying to continue residence: proof that the investment or business plan was carried out must be filed within 90 days of the end of the period granted
program_terms.quote: cuja documentação correspondente deverá ser protocolada em até 90 (noventa) dias do término do prazo concedido
program_terms.notes: "Up to" 90 days. Arts. 5 § 2 and 6 § 4 give an indefinite residence period ("prazo indeterminado"), recorded in words only.

program_terms.applies_to: maximum reduction of the R$1,000,000 minimum for property in the North and Northeast regions
program_terms.quote: O valor mínimo do investimento poderá ser inferior até 30% do total disposto no caput deste artigo
program_terms.notes: Official text of RN 36/2018 (9 Oct 2018), in force on publication in the DOU on 21 Nov 2018 (art. 7). RN 36 was later replaced by RN 46 (2021, per OBMigra), which reportedly kept the main rules.

program_terms.applies_to: only the part of the property investment above R$1,000,000 (or the reduced North/Northeast minimum) may be financed; the minimum itself must be own foreign funds
program_terms.quote: O valor do investimento imobiliário poderá ser objeto de financiamento na parte que exceder o montante de R$ 1.000.000,00 (um milhão de reais)
program_terms.notes: Official text of RN 36/2018 (9 Oct 2018), in force on publication in the DOU on 21 Nov 2018 (art. 7). RN 36 was later replaced by RN 46 (2021, per OBMigra), which reportedly kept the main rules. Art. 2 § 2 allows several properties adding up to the minimum; art. 3 § 1 allows co-ownership if each co-owner invests the minimum.

program_terms.applies_to: initial residence authorisation for a real-estate investor (prior authorisation abroad or in-country grant)
program_terms.quote: O prazo da residência prevista no caput será de 02 (dois) anos.
program_terms.notes: Official text of RN 36/2018 (9 Oct 2018), in force on publication in the DOU on 21 Nov 2018 (art. 7). RN 36 was later replaced by RN 46 (2021, per OBMigra), which reportedly kept the main rules.

program_terms.applies_to: renewal of the initial residence period (up to two years), then change to an indefinite period under RN 30/2018
program_terms.quote: A renovação do prazo inicial de residência, por período de até 02 (dois) anos
program_terms.notes: Official text of RN 36/2018 (9 Oct 2018), in force on publication in the DOU on 21 Nov 2018 (art. 7). RN 36 was later replaced by RN 46 (2021, per OBMigra), which reportedly kept the main rules. "Up to" two years.

program_terms.applies_to: real-estate investor must stay in Brazil at least 30 days during the authorised residence period, counted from registration with the Federal Police
program_terms.quote: O investidor imobiliário deverá permanecer no território nacional por, no mínimo, 30 (trinta) dias durante o prazo concedido
program_terms.notes: Official text of RN 36/2018 (9 Oct 2018), in force on publication in the DOU on 21 Nov 2018 (art. 7). RN 36 was later replaced by RN 46 (2021, per OBMigra), which reportedly kept the main rules.

program_terms.quote: A Resolução Normativa (RN) 84 de 2009 estabeleceu os parâmetros para as autorizações de residência por investimento em atividades produtivas no País, em que se destaca o valor mínimo de R$ 150.000
program_terms.notes: Secondary description by OBMigra; exact dates of RN 84 not given; it was in force until 2015 (replaced by RN 118).

program_terms.quote: substituída pela RN 118, que promoveu algumas mudanças, como, por exemplo, o aumento do valor mínimo do investimento, que passou a ser de R$ 500.000
program_terms.notes: Secondary description by OBMigra; RN 118 replaced in 2017 by RN 13 (same R$500,000, see bra-dou-rn-13-2017).

program_terms.applies_to: urban residential property, built or under construction (RN 36/2018, later RN 46); 30% less in the North and Northeast
program_terms.quote: com valor mínimo de R$ 1.000.000 para imóveis residenciais (construídos ou em construção) sendo 30% menor nas regiões Norte e Nordeste do País
program_terms.notes: Secondary description by OBMigra. RN 46 (2021) kept the main points.

events.title: RN 13/2017 replaces RN 118 for business investors under the new Migration Law
events.description: CNIg Resolução Normativa 13 of 12 Dec 2017, published and in force on 22 Dec 2017, sets residence for individuals investing own foreign funds in a Brazilian company: at least R$500,000 with an investment or business plan (three-year execution), or at least R$150,000 for innovation or research ventures meeting set conditions; it revokes RN 118 of 21 Oct 2015.
events.quote: Art. 8º Revoga-se a Resolução Normativa nº 118, de 21 de outubro de 2015.

events.title: RN 36/2018 real-estate investor residence published and in force
events.description: CNIg Resolução Normativa 36 of 9 Oct 2018, published in the DOU on 21 Nov 2018 and in force on publication: residence for individuals buying urban property (built or under construction) with own foreign funds of at least R$1,000,000, up to 30% less in the North and Northeast; two-year initial residence, at least 30 days in Brazil during it. Same change as e-784734a508 (year only, from OBMigra), here with the exact date from the official text.
events.quote: Esta Resolução Normativa entra em vigor na data de sua publicação.

events.title: RN 46 replaces RN 36 for real-estate investors
events.description: In 2021 CNIg Resolução Normativa 46 replaced RN 36/2018 on residence for real-estate investors, keeping the main points of the original resolution (OBMigra).
events.quote: Em 2021, esta RN foi substituída pela RN 46, que manteve os principais pontos da resolução original.

events.title: RN 84/2009 sets R$150,000 minimum for business investor residence
events.description: CNIg Resolução Normativa 84 of 2009 set the parameters for residence through investment in productive activities, with a minimum of R$150,000 and conditions on job creation, sectors and technology; in force until 2015 (OBMigra). Earlier investor rules were not checked, so this is not shown as the programme launch.
